en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Good idea, since our bodies are important.

Then, let's start off light.
How about 100 push-ups first?

Since this was your idea,
you better not give up, okay?

I've heard stories of botched assassinations
due to lack of planning.

...But gym exercises don't need
image training.

Sometimes you say things that don't
make any sense.

I never know whether I'm composed or not,
but I'm always relieved when I talk to you.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
